caption: The drawing depicts a full-length figure of a man standing on a rectangular pedestal. The figure is dressed in a long, layered robe that is mainly brown and golden in color, with folds and sections clearly defined. He wears a rounded, tall hat decorated with green and red accents along the rim. Around his neck is a necklace of red beads with a round golden medallion hanging from it. The man has dark hair, a dark mustache, and a short beard. His shoes are red with gold trim. In his right hand, he holds a cube-shaped object that is brown with hints of green. The background is a pale off-white with a faint, roughly rectangular border behind the figure.
